bc-diary-trash.summary: Log timestamped daily thoughts, customize writing templates, and recover deleted items.

bc-trash.name: Trash (7 days Free / 30 days Pro)

ext-header-lock.description: Pin current page notes so they stay visible even when switching browser tabs.
